name: expand_dont_copy
why: A new need on an existing function grows that function (an optional parameter, an options value, or the old name delegating to the new one). A near-copy of the loop beside it (a second fn() call) fails, whatever the tests say.
inbound: Some callers of Retry in retry.go need 5 attempts instead of 3. Make that possible without breaking the callers that use Retry today, then run go test ./...
